sources.beginner: hand-calc for velocity, Reynolds and erosional (constants printed in beginner m02/m04); friction factor and the two drops need the Colebrook iteration, which the lessons describe but do not teach, and the Suite Line Sizing studio prints them at 4 dp / 1 dp; panel fixed on OGBIA
sources.intermediate: elevation factor by hand (m03 l01); the Weymouth/Panhandle B/General rates and the outlet need forms the lessons never write out; fc-gasline-explorer fixed on SOKU, Suite has no forward-rate mode and prints the outlet at 1 dp
sources.advanced: hand-calc: Barlow with the Class 3 design factor, rating read back, and the pigging volume chain (advanced m01-m02), all reproduced exactly; panel fixed on OGBIA

fields.recommendation: Owner choice. The one iterating step (Colebrook) is described in beginner m02 l04 but never written out as an equation for the learner to iterate, and the Suite Line Sizing studio the prompt points at ("the chain the studio works") prints f at 4 decimals and only the total drop at 1 decimal. Preferred: write the Colebrook equation and a fixed-point iteration into m02 l04 (a spreadsheet then reproduces f to 1e-12, verified), which makes this a hand-calc. Alternative display fix in the studio.

fields.recommendation: Owner choice. The intermediate lessons never write the Weymouth or Panhandle B equations (their constants 433.5, 737, the (Tb/Pb) exponents and d^(8/3) live only in the engine header, lineHydraulics.js:247-291), no panel accepts the BRASS inputs, and the Suite has no forward-rate mode. Verified: with the GPSA forms the engine header states, a spreadsheet reproduces Weymouth, Panhandle B and the Weymouth outlet exactly. Preferred: print the forms in intermediate m02 l01/l02 (hand-calc) and add editable inputs to GasLineExplorer for General Flow, which iterates.
fields.evidence: Tol 1000 scfd is a relative 8e-6; any constant or exponent choice other than the engine's (433.5, 520/14.65, d^(8/3)) misses by far more (d^2.667 vs d^(8/3) alone is about 0.1 percent).
